rationale.consistency: Follows standard Go idioms and integrates seamlessly with the existing codebase.
rationale.edge_cases: Correctly identifies and groups '%xx' sequences, preserving escapes while safely handling malformed inputs.
rationale.scope: Strictly solves the requested suffix stripping issue without any unrelated refactors or changes.
rationale.readability: Excellent comments and straightforward logic make the atom-reversal strategy very easy to understand.
rationale.robustness: Safe against bounds errors, though splitting the string into an array of single-byte strings is allocation-heavy.
rationale.maintainability: Helper functions are logically separated, well-scoped, and completely decouple the reversal logic from path mutation.
